modeDesc: Turn the quiz into a map with checkpoints, treasure, runs and a friendly boss

dino.name: Dinosaur Island
dino.desc: Waterfalls, giant ferns and a volcano that only sneezes.

bakery.name: Kitty Bakery
bakery.desc: Warm ovens, cupcake hills and cats who love frosting.

space.name: Space Adventure
space.desc: Planets, comets and a rocket that never stops humming.

pirate.name: Pirate Treasure
pirate.desc: Sandy islands, a parrot friend and a chest full of gold.

unicorn.name: Unicorn Rainbow
unicorn.desc: Cloud bridges, sparkles and a rainbow to climb.

panda.name: Panda Forest
panda.desc: Bamboo paths, cherry blossoms and a sleepy panda village.

fire.name: Firefighter Rescue
fire.desc: Sirens, ladders and brave helpers saving the town.

candy.name: Candy World
candy.desc: Lollipop trees, chocolate rivers and jelly bridges.

camping.name: Camping Adventure
camping.desc: Tents, campfire songs and stars over the pine trees.

dessert.name: Sweet Dessert Land
dessert.desc: Ice cream mountains, cookie roads and pudding lakes.

4-5.label: Little explorer
rules: 2 tries per question; two wrong answers go back one checkpoint
Gentle adventure runs: slow monsters, no spiky ones

6-7.label: Explorer
rules: A "Read it to me" button on every question
2 tries per question; two wrong answers go back one checkpoint

8-10.label: Adventurer
rules: A "Read it to me" button on every question
2 tries per question; two wrong answers go back one checkpoint
Faster monsters in adventure runs, every kind

easy.label: Easy
easy.desc: 3 hearts, a free hint on every question and a gentle boss.

medium.label: Medium
medium.desc: 3 hearts, hints after a wrong answer or with hint tokens.

hard.label: Hard
hard.desc: 2 hearts, hints only with tokens from the shop.

perfect.name: Perfect!
perfect.desc: Every answer right the first time

heart.name: +1 heart
heart.desc: Get one heart back right now.

hint.name: Hint token
hint.desc: Removes one wrong answer from any question, even in boss battles.

party.name: Party hat
party.desc: A stripy party look for your hero.

hero.title: Who's playing today?
hero.ready: {{name}} the {{hero}} is ready for the adventure!

welcome.title: Welcome back, {{name}}!
welcome.desc: You stopped at checkpoint {{n}} of {{total}}. Your coins, stars and rewards are saved.
welcome.startOverNote: Starting over keeps your first answers for your teacher.

map.missionChest: A treasure chest is close. Answer to move forward!
map.missionGame: Game time! Checkpoint {{n}}: play an adventure run, or take a quiz card.
map.missionMini: {{boss}} blocks the bridge. Answer {{count}} questions to get past!
map.missionBoss: {{boss}} guards the castle. Time for the big battle!

quiz.noHints: No hint tokens left. Buy one in the Shop!
quiz.youPicked: You picked {{answer}} — so close. Let's try again.
quiz.lastHeart: Last heart! Hearts fill back up at every flag.
quiz.stepBack: Let's go back one checkpoint and come back stronger!
quiz.noReveal: Ask your teacher to show you this one later.
quiz.recordedDesc: Your teacher will look at this one.
quiz.streakChest: Streak {{n}}! A treasure chest is waiting!
quiz.howPlay: How do you want to play?
quiz.cardDesc: Answer one question. Quick and calm.
quiz.runDesc: Run, jump, bop monsters — then hit the right answer block!

chest.title: Treasure unlocked!
chest.keyDesc: Use it in Rewards to open the secret treasure room
chest.petDesc: Follows you on the map and brings a hint token at every flag
chest.later: Find everything later in Rewards on the map.

flag.title: Checkpoint reached!
flag.savedDesc: Hearts are full again. If you run out later, you only go back one step.
flag.petHint: Your pet brought a hint token!
flag.nextBoss: The final boss is waiting at the castle.
flag.nextMore: More treasure further along the path.

boss.magic: Every answer is a little magic
boss.question: Boss question {{n}} of {{total}}
boss.friend: You did it! A new friend!
boss.lostDesc: Let's practise one more checkpoint and try the battle again.

rewards.title: Rewards & Shop
rewards.coinsDesc: Spend them in the Shop on hearts, hint tokens and hats.
rewards.hintsDesc: On any question, tap the bulb button to remove one wrong answer. Works in boss battles too.
rewards.keyDesc: Opens the secret treasure room: +80 coins and the Royal Crown. Find it in your first treasure chest (4 right answers in a row).
rewards.roomOpened: Treasure room opened! +80 coins and the Royal Crown.
rewards.petDesc: Follows you on the map and brings you a hint token at every flag. Find it in your second treasure chest.
rewards.noHats: No hats yet. Win the crown from your third chest, or buy hats in the Shop.
